If there were a leverage effect in practice, what would be the shape of the news impact curve for as model that accounted for that leverage?
Option A: It would rise more quickly for negative disturbances than for positive ones of the same magnitude
Option B: It would be symmetrical about zero
Option C: It would rise less quickly for negative disturbances than for positive ones of the same magnitude
Option D: It would be zero for all positive disturbances
